$comment: Curated, non-pricing product truth for OnAlert. Edit here only. scripts/gen-product-truth.mjs merges this with src/data/pricing.json + build metadata into public/.well-known/product-truth.json (the single source the Mindmaker fleet sells from) and public/llms.txt. Keep capabilityStatus honest: agents must never promise a 'partial' or 'roadmap' capability as live.

product.name: OnAlert
product.oneSentencePitch: OnAlert watches the CBP Trusted Traveler scheduler 24/7 and alerts you within minutes when an interview slot opens, so months of refreshing become a booking in days.
product.category: Real-time CBP Trusted Traveler (Global Entry, NEXUS, SENTRI) appointment alerts
product.programsNote: All three include TSA PreCheck. There is no standalone TSA PreCheck monitor.

icp.definition: A person who is (1) applied or intending to apply for a CBP Trusted Traveler Program, (2) conditionally approved, and (3) facing a weeks-to-months wait for the in-person interview at their preferred enrollment center. All three true means a high-intent buyer.
icp.painfulProblem: Conditionally-approved travelers face a 3 to 12 month interview wait. Cancellation slots open invisibly and refill in 5 to 15 minutes, and the CBP scheduler has no notification capability, so only whoever happens to be refreshing at that moment wins. Manual refreshing is a losing game by design.
icp.magicMoment: The instant a slot opens, a multi-channel alert (email, SMS, web push, in-app realtime) reaches you within seconds, with a one-tap deep link straight into the CBP scheduler at the right location.

offerDecisionRules.if: 3+ locations selected, or coordinating multiple people
single program, one airport, wants SMS + fast checks

currentOffer.note: No promotional offer is currently live. Do not promise a money-back guarantee or referral discount until their status below is 'live'.

capabilityStatusNote: Reflects current shippable reality, not the marketing matrix. 'partial'/'degraded'/'inactive'/'in_progress'/'stub'/'roadmap' must not be sold as live. Updated as features ship during the 2026-05 rebuild.
northStarMetric: Successful bookings attributed to OnAlert (a booking-CTA click within 15 minutes of an alert, where the slot then disappears from the CBP API).

brand.personality: Bloomberg-terminal calm: dark, precise, confident, helpful, urgent but never alarmist.

rules: Crimson is reserved for things that matter; do not overuse urgency.
